name: Bookyt Rental Software
author: PHCOM GmbH

sections.description:
Rental software for WordPress

Connect your Bookyt account to WordPress to display rental offers, availability, locations, news, and online booking.

For businesses renting vehicles, trailers, bicycles, tools, equipment, or other items. A Bookyt account with API access is required.

What can you add to your website?

  • Rental categories and detail pages with images, descriptions, and equipment
  • Availability calendar and compact date checks
  • Direct booking buttons and featured offers
  • Embedded Bookyt online booking
  • Occupancy plan with day, week, and month views
  • Vehicle occupancy calendar with period selection and booking handoff
  • Locations with contact details and opening hours
  • News from your Bookyt account

Connect Bookyt once

Enter your account name, access token, and language under Settings → Bookyt.

Choose a language or Automatic to follow WordPress, with English as the fallback for unsupported languages.

Then add a shortcode:

[bookyt call="calendar"]

Keep credentials in the settings. Optional account and token shortcode attributes override them, for example when using multiple accounts.

Available calls

The call parameter selects the content. Its default is category.

Rental categories: category

Shows categories with images and descriptions. Selecting an offer opens its details.

[bookyt call="category"]

Single rental item: item

Shows an item’s description, equipment, and images. category_id is its Bookyt category ID.

[bookyt call="item" category_id="4"]

Featured rental offers: featured

Shows selected categories in a compact grid. category_id accepts comma-separated IDs; without it, the first three categories appear.

[bookyt call="featured" category_id="4,7,12"]

Availability calendar: calendar

Checks availability for a selected rental period, location, and category.

[bookyt call="calendar"]

Optional location preselection:

[bookyt call="calendar" station_id="1"]

Compact availability check: availability

Checks a selected start date, rental period, location, and category against live availability.

[bookyt call="availability"]

Optional preselection:

[bookyt call="availability" station_id="1" category_id="4"]

Embedded online booking: embed

Embeds the complete booking frontend. Requires an account, but no access token.

[bookyt call="embed"]

Direct booking button: booking_button

Opens Bookyt booking with an optional location and category. Requires an account, but no access token.

[bookyt call="booking_button" station_id="1" category_id="4"]

Occupancy plan: belegungsplan

Shows rental-item occupancy by day, week, or month, with location and category filters.

[bookyt call="belegungsplan" station_id="1,2" category_id="4,5" view="month"]

Filters accept comma-separated IDs; omitted filters show all entries. view accepts day, week, or month.

Occupancy calendar: belegungskalender

Shows a classic monthly calendar with free, occupied, and partially occupied days per vehicle, without a preset rental duration. Select pickup and return dates, then continue to booking with the location, category, and period. Account timezone and fixed pickup/return times apply.

[bookyt call="belegungskalender"]

Optional filters and a fixed calendar vehicle:

[bookyt call="belegungskalender" station_id="1" category_id="4" resource_id="7"]

A single explicit station_id, category_id, or resource_id fixes its value and hides its selector. Fields also hide when only one option remains. Comma-separated location/category ID lists retain a choice when multiple options remain. Fields adapt dynamically; hidden values remain active for the calendar and booking handoff.

The alias call="occupancy_calendar" is supported. The separate widget uses data-view="occupancy_calendar", with data-station-id, data-category-id, and data-resource-id (JavaScript: stationId, categoryId, resourceId).

Both integrations refresh occupancy before booking handoff and after returning. Assigned bookings and vehicle blocks cover one year from today; dates outside this window cannot be selected.

Requires the Bookyt endpoint extension include_calendar=1 for blocks, booking rules, and coverage. Without these fields, booking stays disabled. Final availability, unassigned category reservations, rental conditions, and vehicle assignment are checked in the booking frontend. A fixed calendar vehicle does not guarantee its booking assignment.

Rental locations: locations

Shows locations and their information from Bookyt.

[bookyt call="locations"]

News: news

Shows news from Bookyt.

[bookyt call="news"]

Shortcode parameters

  • call: Bookyt view.
  • account, token: override the central settings.
  • station_id: location filter or preselection.
  • category_id: category filter or item selection.
  • resource_id: fixed vehicle in the occupancy calendar.
  • view: occupancy-plan view (day, week, month).

Supported languages

German, English, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Greek, and Turkish. The selected language applies to plugin labels and Bookyt content requests.

External Bookyt service

Bookyt is an externally hosted service. Pages with Bookyt shortcodes request content from the configured account at *.bookyt.de, sending the account, access token, language, and relevant location/category filters.

embed and `booking_button` load the Bookyt frontend without a token; visitors interact directly with Bookyt. Displaying Bookyt content requires a connected account.

See the Bookyt privacy policy and include the embedded service in your website privacy information where required.

More about Bookyt Rental Software

Learn more about Bookyt Rental Software and PHCOM GmbH.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Bookyt Rental Software in WordPress.
  2. Have a Bookyt account with API access enabled.
  3. Open Settings → Bookyt.
  4. Enter the account prefix, token, and language.
  5. Use Check account and save the settings.
  6. Add a shortcode to a page, post, or shortcode-compatible widget.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Bookyt account?

Yes. Product and trial information is available at bookyt.de.

Where do I enter the account and access token?

Under Settings → Bookyt. Shortcodes normally need no credentials.

Can I use more than one Bookyt account?

Yes. Set account and token in a shortcode to override the central settings.

Do the embedded booking and direct booking button require a token?

No. Both require an account, but no token.

What happens when I select Automatic language?

It follows the WordPress language, with English as the fallback for unsupported languages.

Where can I get support?

Use the Bookyt support area or email service@phcom.de.
sections.changelog:
2.26

  • Add occupancy calendar with period selection and booking handoff.

2.25

  • Belegungsplan Update.

2.24

  • Improved category cards with centered, uncropped images in a larger 4:3 display area.

2.23

  • Added Polish language support for plugin labels, calendars, and Bookyt requests.
  • Added shortcodes for featured rental offers, compact live availability checks, and direct booking buttons.
  • Secured availability requests with WordPress nonces and server-side token contexts.
  • Improved calendar handling and styling for the new booking views.

2.22

  • Added central settings for the Bookyt account, access token, and language.
  • Added support for German, English, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Greek, and Turkish.
  • Expanded shortcode documentation for all supported Bookyt views.
  • Reworked the WordPress.org description and replaced banners, icons, and screenshots.
